recipes.name: gitlab-mr-watch
recipes.description: Watch new comments on a specific GitLab MR. Each new review note dispatches the mr-review-fix pipeline — Claude reads the comment + the current MR diff, edits files in the matching local project, and pushes a fixup commit.
recipes.author: forge

recipes.name: gitlab-my-mrs-watch
recipes.display_name: GitLab — watch ALL my MRs for review feedback
recipes.description: Auto-monitor every open MR you authored across all GitLab projects. Each new review comment dispatches mr-review-fix to the local project — no per-MR setup.
recipes.author: forge

recipes.name: mantis-bug-fix
recipes.display_name: Mantis — fix one bug by id
recipes.description: Manual / one-shot: fix a single Mantis bug. Press Fire when you're ready; Claude takes it from there. For continuous polling, use mantis-bug-watch.
recipes.author: forge

recipes.name: mantis-bug-watch
recipes.description: Continuously poll Mantis with a filter (status / assignee / fix_schedule / project). New matches dispatch mantis-bug-fix-and-mr. Dedup by bug id.
recipes.author: forge

recipes.name: mantis-bug-fix-batch
recipes.display_name: Mantis — fix many bugs by id list
recipes.description: Hand-picked batch fixer: paste a comma-separated list of Mantis bug ids, Fire once, get one mantis-bug-fix-and-mr pipeline per id. Per-Job max_per_tick caps concurrency.
recipes.author: forge

recipes.name: gitlab-mr-author-watch
recipes.display_name: GitLab MR auto-fix (all MRs I authored)
recipes.description: Filter-based watch for all my open MRs. Auto-dispatches mr-review-fix when a reviewer adds a comment.
recipes.author: forge

recipes.name: gitlab-mr-reviewer-watch
recipes.display_name: GitLab MR pre-review (MRs assigned to me to review)
recipes.description: Filter-based watch for MRs assigned to me as reviewer. Runs mr-pre-review pipeline (analyze + post comment + open Forge chat session).
recipes.author: forge

pipelines.name: mr-review-fix
pipelines.description: GitLab MR review-feedback responder: a Claude triage step decides ACT vs SKIP per the user's plain-text triage_instructions, then (if ACT) checks out the source branch and pushes a fixup commit. Replaces the v0.1 regex/whitelist filter. Requires glab CLI authenticated.
pipelines.author: forge

pipelines.name: mantis-bug-fix-and-mr
pipelines.description: Fetch Mantis bug context → worktree → Claude proposes a fix → push branch → open GitLab MR via glab → notify assignee + reporter on Teams. Used by the mantis-bug-fix / mantis-bug-watch recipes.
pipelines.author: forge

pipelines.name: mr-pre-review
pipelines.description: Analyze diff + post '🤖 Forge pre-review:' comment + open Forge chat session for the human reviewer to decide approve/request-changes.
pipelines.author: forge

pipelines.name: issue-fix-and-review
pipelines.description: Fetch GitHub issue → Claude proposes fix → push branch + open PR → AI code review.
pipelines.author: forge

pipelines.name: multi-agent-collaboration
pipelines.description: Two-agent conversation: architect designs, implementer codes. Demo / template for custom multi-agent flows.
pipelines.author: forge

pipelines.name: review-mr
pipelines.description: GitHub PR auto-review: fetch diff → analyze → post markdown review comment via gh. Use mr-review-fix for GitLab MRs.
pipelines.author: forge

pipelines.name: fortinet-mantis-bug-fix
pipelines.description: Single-shot Fortinet Mantis bug → fix → MR pipeline. Input is just bug_id + project + base_branch + three editable prompts (focus / MR body / Teams message). Fetches summary/description/reporter/assignee/etc from Mantis at run time, has Claude propose a minimal fix, opens a GitLab MR via glab, notifies assignee + reporter on Teams.
pipelines.author: forge

pipelines.name: fortinet-mr-pre-review
pipelines.description: Single-shot Fortinet GitLab MR pre-review. User provides an MR URL; pipeline fetches MR meta + diff + discussion, runs Claude analysis per user_prompt focus, posts a '🤖 Forge pre-review:' comment, and opens a Forge chat session for the human reviewer to drill into. Copy of mr-pre-review simplified for manual single runs.
pipelines.author: forge

pipelines.name: fortinet-mr-review
pipelines.description: Single-shot Fortinet GitLab MR review responder. User provides an MR URL; pipeline reads all comments + diff, triages (act/skip/close/noop) per user_prompt policy, optionally pushes a fixup commit, replies on the MR, and notifies Teams. Copy of mr-review-fix simplified for manual single runs.
pipelines.author: forge
